horseyDatabase.title: Horsey CRISPR Database
horseyDatabase.description: Browse, edit and hybridise Horsey DNA using local templates and data.

tips: You can pet your horse by moving the mouse back and forth, or press G to whip it hard!
The horse races on the tavern TV pick real champions, who then race in the championship.
Clever horses randomly set up studs in the wild and join races.
You can temporarily release your horse into the wild so it can take care of its needs on its own.
You can start the lab manually by repeatedly clicking the lamp at the top—no need to power the plant.
If you put a horse in Flask Bay on the real-world map, you’ll see the horses there in the gene editor.
Click the sign to change the race distance at the abandoned track.
Meat dropped when a horse dies can be turned back into the original horse with DNA.
You can reclaim land from the sea using fences.
Dig fully grown grass or buy hay blocks; placing one turns the surrounding nine tiles into grass.
Dig irradiated grass or the power plant for radioactive matter; placing it irradiates the surrounding nine tiles.
Place apples on the map to grow apple trees.
Crocodiles only breed on the water surface.
You can fill pits with any item—you’ll get that item back when you dig there again.
When renaming a horse, unsupported characters show up as various pictogram horses.

editor.name: Name
editor.qe_lead: One-click shortcuts for common allele bundles. Changes sync to the text area and both views.
editor.qe_group_vitals_hint: Targets helix 01 (behaviour / gut) for lifespan and litter-size tweaks.
editor.qe_group_limbs_hint: Leg count and wheeled legs; the wheels option merges leg- and foot-related stretches from the wheels preset when available.
editor.qe_group_metabolism_hint: Combines OMNIVORE on helix 01 with digestion slots on helix 12 for herbivore / carnivore / omnivore-style setups.

helixDescriptions.0: Overall body proportions and skeletal structure.
helixDescriptions.1: Gut shape, behaviour tendency, and coat patterning.
helixDescriptions.2: Limb flexibility and muscle force modulation.
helixDescriptions.3: Joint range of motion and geometric angles.
helixDescriptions.4: Limb type tags and counts (e.g. leg count).
helixDescriptions.5: Gait style (walk/run, etc.) and upper-arm structure.
helixDescriptions.6: Torso volume ratio and neck silhouette.
helixDescriptions.7: Tail presence, length, and wag behaviour.
helixDescriptions.8: Leg and arm length and thickness.
helixDescriptions.9: Foot and hand shape and attachment.
helixDescriptions.11: Eye and ear shape and placement.
helixDescriptions.13: Antler body and hat pom details.
helixDescriptions.16: Base coat colour and colour mixing.
helixDescriptions.18: Run speed and overall locomotion tuning.
helixDescriptions.19: Synchronisation signals between limbs and torso.

geneDescriptions.SIZE: Scales the overall body size, affecting the creature's skeleton and apparent mass.
geneDescriptions.BONES: Sets the primary skeletal scale and broad frame proportions.
geneDescriptions.BONES2: Fine-tunes secondary skeletal proportions on top of the main bone scale.
geneDescriptions.OSTODERM: Adds bony skin plates/osteoderms. Related to OSTO_SIZE, which controls their scale.
geneDescriptions.OSTO_SIZE: Controls spike size if dorsal spikes/osteoderms are present. Most relevant when OSTODERM is active.
geneDescriptions.GIANT_DWARF: Applies a body scale preset: A=66 dwarf, C=133 giant, T/G=100 normal. Stacks with other body proportion genes.
geneDescriptions.TAIL_BOTTOM: Controls tail attachment/bottom setting visually and appears to serve as an internal structural anchor/sentinel in game data.
geneDescriptions.LEG_STRETCH2: Adds a second leg-length stretch layer on top of LEG_STRETCH.
geneDescriptions.ARM_STRETCH2: Adds a second arm-length stretch layer on top of ARM_STRETCH.
geneDescriptions.HEAD_THICK_SKULL: Controls skull thickness and the raised crown of the head.
geneDescriptions.NECK_STIFF: Disables or reduces neck flexibility. A and G are stiff values; T/C are flexible values. May suppress NECK_FLEXIBILITY and related neck motion.
geneDescriptions.GUT: Controls abdomen volume and the outline of the midsection.
geneDescriptions.GUT_IS_UDDER: Transforms the body mesh into an udder-like shape by offsetting ventral geometry. Visual effect only.
geneDescriptions.DERRIERE: Controls rump size and the volume of the hindquarters.
geneDescriptions.LEG_IS_CIRCLE: Changes leg geometry into a circular/wheel-like form. T is active.
geneDescriptions.FOOT_IS_CIRCLE: Changes foot geometry into a circular/wheel-like form. A is active.
geneDescriptions.TONGUE: Controls tongue length and how far it protrudes.
geneDescriptions.TONGUE_SEGS: Sets the number of visible tongue segments.
geneDescriptions.BELLY_ALT: Controls whether the belly pattern uses the alternate coat colour.
geneDescriptions.PAT_BELLY: Controls belly pattern strength and distribution.
geneDescriptions.LITTER_SIZE: Directly controls number of offspring per birth. A=3, T=2, C=1, G=5. G is the high-litter allele.
geneDescriptions.OLD_AGE: Applies progressive physical degradation over time through visible body-coordinate perturbations. C=-1, G=2, A/T=0. Retirement age itself appears hardcoded.
geneDescriptions.OMNIVORE: Enables carnivorous/omnivorous behaviour. A is active in the wiki table; T/C/G are inactive. When active, the horse may chase and eat NPCs or other horses instead of grazing normally.
geneDescriptions.LIMP: Affects gait asymmetry. C produces the strong limp value, G the slight limp value, A/T are normal. Likely worsens with age.
geneDescriptions.MUSCLE_USE: Global body-wide force multiplier used throughout movement physics. C/G give maximum output; higher values give more power but can make movement more erratic.
geneDescriptions.TAIL_STIFF: Binary/low-range modifier that reduces or disables tail flexibility. T and C are stiff values.
geneDescriptions.LEG_FLEXIBILITY: Controls how freely the legs bend during locomotion.
geneDescriptions.TAIL_FLEXIBILITY: Controls tail bending range. G is highest, C is lowest.
geneDescriptions.TAIL_SPEED: Controls tail movement speed. C=200 is fastest; T=0 is still.
geneDescriptions.LEG_AND_ARM_LIMP: Applies limp to all limbs simultaneously instead of just an asymmetric gait. C is active in the wiki table.
geneDescriptions.ARM_STRENGTH: Controls front-limb power and load-bearing strength.
geneDescriptions.ARM_FLEXIBILITY: Controls how freely the arms/front limbs bend.
geneDescriptions.NECK_FLEXIBILITY: Controls how freely the neck can bend during movement. C is high, G/A/T are lower depending on desired stiffness.
geneDescriptions.BRAIN_SPASTIC: Applies random positional jitter each tick, causing twitching and erratic movement. A is the strongest spasm value, G is mild, T/C are none. When active, it may suppress visible old-age perturbation effects.
geneDescriptions.SPLAY: Controls toe splay or webbing spread.
geneDescriptions.LEG_IN: Applies an inward geometric bias to the legs.
geneDescriptions.LEG_IN2: Adds a secondary fine adjustment to inward leg posture.
geneDescriptions.TAIL_ANGLE: Controls the tail's raised angle relative to the spine.
geneDescriptions.LEG_JOINT_TYPE: Selects leg joint type and articulation.
geneDescriptions.HAS_KNEE: Toggles knee joint presence. C is active.
geneDescriptions.HAS_ELBOW: Toggles elbow joint presence. A is active.
geneDescriptions.HEAD_JOINTED: Controls whether head is jointed or rigidly fixed. A is active.
geneDescriptions.STIFF_JOINTS: Reduces joint flexibility. A is the stiffest value in the wiki table; T/C are 0 and G is moderate.
geneDescriptions.LEG_HAS_FOOT: Controls whether legs terminate with feet. A/G present; T/C absent.
geneDescriptions.LEG_COUNT: Controls number of legs. A=7 is the high-leg-count setting.
geneDescriptions.LEG_THRUST_BACK: Controls hind-leg push-off force and backswing bias.
geneDescriptions.ARM_HAS_HAND: Controls whether arms terminate with hands. T/C present; A/G absent.
geneDescriptions.NECK_SLOUCH: Tilts the neck forward into a slouched, hunched posture.
geneDescriptions.NECK_ONTOP: Raises the neck's attachment so it sits higher on the torso.
geneDescriptions.BREAK_FORCE: Controls stamina/rest drain behaviour. T or G gives 0, which may help speed because lower values reduce braking/rest pressure.
geneDescriptions.EAR_X: Controls horizontal ear placement relative to the centre of the head.
geneDescriptions.QUADRUPED: Enables quadrupedal locomotion mode. A/C are active according to the wiki table.
geneDescriptions.BIPED: Enables bipedal locomotion mode. A/C are active according to the wiki table.
geneDescriptions.UPARM_Y: Controls vertical placement of upper arms relative to the body.
geneDescriptions.ARM_FORWARD: Controls how far the forearms pitch forward or back.
geneDescriptions.UPARM_ANGLE: Controls the pitch angle of the upper arm at the shoulder.
geneDescriptions.WHITE_IS_LETHAL: If active and WHITE coat is expressed in a foal, a lethal check may be applied at birth. G is the active lethal-white value according to the wiki table.
geneDescriptions.ASPECT: Controls the torso's width-to-height ratio and overall body aspect.
geneDescriptions.SKINNY: Biases the body towards a slimmer, leaner build.
geneDescriptions.CHEST_BIG: Controls broad chest volume and ribcage mass.
geneDescriptions.CHEST_SMALL: Affects body size and chest shape. Likely complements or opposes CHEST_BIG depending on expression.
geneDescriptions.NECK_TYPE: Selects the neck's structural shape variant.
geneDescriptions.NECK_ANGLE: Controls the pitch angle at the base of the neck.
geneDescriptions.NECK_COCK: Adds a sideways neck tilt or head-cocked posture.
geneDescriptions.TAIL_EXISTS: Controls whether a tail is present. C disables; A/G present; T has value 2.
geneDescriptions.TAIL_SHORT: Controls how strongly the tail is shortened.
geneDescriptions.TAIL_ASPECT: Controls tail thickness/roundness in cross-section. Lower values make it flatter/thinner; higher values thicker/rounder.
geneDescriptions.TAIL_SHAPE: Controls tail curvature by bending the currently selected tail mesh. Higher values produce stronger curve.
geneDescriptions.TAIL_SEGMENTS: Controls the number of tail segments.
geneDescriptions.TAIL_WAG: Controls whether and how strongly the tail wag animation plays.
geneDescriptions.LEG_LENGTH: Controls leg length. T=120 is the longest-leg allele and can improve stride length.
geneDescriptions.LEG_STRETCH: Applies stretching to leg length beyond base LEG_LENGTH.
geneDescriptions.LEG_STRENGTH: Controls leg force output. C=120 is the highest-value allele for raw leg force; useful for racing if stable locomotion is preserved.
geneDescriptions.LEG_PENCIL: Makes the legs thinner, like pencil legs.
geneDescriptions.ARM_STRETCH: Applies stretching to arm length beyond base ARM_LENGTH.
geneDescriptions.ARM_NODE_SCALE: Controls scaling of internal arm segments/nodes.
geneDescriptions.HAS_FOOT: Toggles whether feet are present. T/C present, A/G absent.
geneDescriptions.FOOT_CLOWN: Gives the feet an exaggerated clown-shoe shape.
geneDescriptions.FOOT_THICKNESS: Controls how thick or bulky feet are.
geneDescriptions.HAS_HAND: Toggles whether hands are present on arms. A/G present, T/C absent.
geneDescriptions.SKIN_HANDS: Controls whether hands use skin-like rendering/material.
geneDescriptions.HEAD_SIZE: Controls head scale. Values are additive across both strands: A=75, T=133, C=50, G=100.
geneDescriptions.HEAD_X_GROWTH: Directional scaling along head X axis. T narrows, C/G widen.
geneDescriptions.HEAD_Y_GROWTH: Directional scaling along head Y axis. A increases, C compresses, T/G neutral.
geneDescriptions.HEAD_ASPECT: Controls the aspect ratio of the head. Works alongside HEAD_SIZE.
geneDescriptions.HEAD_SQUARE: Biases the head toward a square/block-like form. T is strongest, A partial, C/G off.
geneDescriptions.HEAD_HAS_BACK: Controls rear/back-of-head geometry. G=11 is extended, A=1 is present, T/C are off.
geneDescriptions.HEAD_GIANT: Additional head enlargement modifier. A/T are large; C/G are normal.
geneDescriptions.HEAD_SHRUNK: Additional head reduction modifier. T=50 is most shrunken, A=70 partial, C/G normal.
geneDescriptions.HEAD_CHIMERA: Enables mixed or blended head structure. T is active.
geneDescriptions.EYEBOX_SIZE: Controls the size of the eye socket region containing the eyes.
geneDescriptions.SKIN_HEAD: Controls whether head uses skin-like rendering/material.
geneDescriptions.EYE_STYLE: Selects eye type/style variant. Treated as a discrete style selector rather than a continuous physical parameter.
geneDescriptions.BUGEYE: Controls eye protrusion. T=2 is most bulging, A=1 is partial, C/G are flat.
geneDescriptions.EYE_SIZE: Controls eye size. Values are additive across both strands: A=50, T=125, C=75, G=50.
geneDescriptions.PUPIL_SIZE: Controls pupil diameter. A=80 is largest; T/G=40 are smallest; C=66 is mid-sized.
geneDescriptions.HAS_PUPIL: Toggles pupils. A is active; T/C/G disable pupils.
geneDescriptions.BROW_SIZE: Controls brow ridge size. A/T are prominent; C/G are off.
geneDescriptions.BROW_SLANT: Controls brow ridge angle. A and T tilt in opposite directions.
geneDescriptions.EAR_SHAPE: Controls general ear form within the selected style.
geneDescriptions.EAR_SLANT: Controls ear angle/tilt relative to the head.
geneDescriptions.EAR_INTERIOR: Controls inner-ear detail. T is active.
geneDescriptions.EAR_FLOP: Controls how much the ears droop or flop downward. G is very floppy.
geneDescriptions.TEETH_SHAPE: Selects tooth form/style. May affect whether the horse behaves more like a herbivore, carnivore, or omnivore in addition to visible tooth shape.
geneDescriptions.HAS_MOUTH: Controls whether a mouth exists. G disables the mouth; A/T/C keep it present.
geneDescriptions.MOUTH_SIZE: Controls mouth opening scale and overall size.
geneDescriptions.JAW: Controls jaw shape and forward projection.
geneDescriptions.TEETH_UPPER2: Controls the secondary upper-teeth shape setting.
geneDescriptions.NOSE_INNY: Controls how recessed or indented the nose appears.
geneDescriptions.FLU_IMMUNITY: Grants immunity to the flu mechanic. G is immune; A/T/C are susceptible. This appears tied to the sickness/immunity mechanic sometimes referred to as Sweetie.
geneDescriptions.ANTLER_X: Controls antler spread across the horizontal axis.
geneDescriptions.ANTLER_TAPER: Controls how sharply the antlers taper towards their tips.
geneDescriptions.ANTLER_POM: Controls the size of the pom at the antler tip.
geneDescriptions.ANTLER_COLOR: Controls the antler material colour setting.
geneDescriptions.POM_USECOLOR: Controls whether poms use their own colour instead of inheriting another colour.
geneDescriptions.HAT_POM: Controls the size of the pom on the hat.
geneDescriptions.HAT_POM_IS_LID: Controls whether the hat pom also acts as a brim or lid shade.
geneDescriptions.ANTLER_REC2: Controls the secondary recursive antler branch form.
geneDescriptions.ANTLER_FLIP: Mirrors the antlers left to right.
geneDescriptions.ANTLER_MOD: Controls antler modulation or twist style.
geneDescriptions.ANTLER_ANGLE: Controls the main antler branch angle.
geneDescriptions.ANTLER_ANGLE2: Controls the secondary antler branch angle.
geneDescriptions.ANTLER_ANGLE_RAND: Adds random variation to antler angles.
geneDescriptions.ANTLER_T1: Controls antler texture or thickness parameter T1.
geneDescriptions.ANTLER_T2: Controls antler texture or thickness parameter T2.
geneDescriptions.HAT_EXISTS: Controls whether a hat is present.
geneDescriptions.HAT_TAPER: Controls hat taper and brim narrowing.
geneDescriptions.HAT_CLONE: Controls hat cloning or symmetric duplication.
geneDescriptions.HAT_BACK_SCALE: Controls the scale of the back of the hat.
geneDescriptions.HAT_FRONT_SCALE: Controls the scale of the front of the hat.
geneDescriptions.HAT_BACK_ANGLE: Controls the fold angle at the back of the hat.
geneDescriptions.HAT_ANGLE_RAND: Adds random variation to hat angle.
geneDescriptions.HAT_T: Controls hat thickness or material parameter T.
geneDescriptions.BASE_BROWN: Controls contribution of brown pigment to base coat colour.
geneDescriptions.BASE_BLACK: Controls contribution of black pigment to base coat colour.
geneDescriptions.BASE_RED: Controls contribution of red pigment to base coat colour.
geneDescriptions.BASE_GREEN: Controls contribution of green pigment to base coat colour.
geneDescriptions.GREEN_KNOCKOUT: Suppresses/removes green pigment from final coat colour. A is active.
geneDescriptions.BASE_CREAM: Adds cream/light pigment into base coat colour. G=100 is active.
geneDescriptions.ALT_BLUE: Controls blue tint in alternate/secondary colour layers.
geneDescriptions.SPOT_YELLOW: Controls yellow pigmentation in spot/pattern regions.
geneDescriptions.SWAP_BASE_SPOT: Swaps the base coat colour with the spot/pattern colour, inverting the colour distribution.
geneDescriptions.SWAP_ALT_SPOT: Swaps the alternate colour layer with the spot colour layer. Can combine with SWAP_BASE_SPOT.
geneDescriptions.WHITE: Activates white coat expression. T is active in the wiki table. If WHITE_IS_LETHAL is also active, white foals may die at birth.
geneDescriptions.NOSE_HUE: Controls nose colour independently of overall skin tone.
geneDescriptions.HOOF_COLOR: Controls colour of hooves or hoof-like structures.
geneDescriptions.AGOUTI: Restricts pigment to the extremities, producing a bay-like pattern with darker points and lighter body/belly regions.
geneDescriptions.FOOT_IS_HOOF: Switches feet to hoof-like structures. A/T active; C/G off.
geneDescriptions.COON_EYE: Applies a dark eye-mask marking. A is strongest, C is partial, T/G are off.
geneDescriptions.EAR_COMP: Applies alternate/complementary colour to the ears. C is the strongest value, A is lower, T/G are off.
geneDescriptions.TAIL_ALT: Selects between different prebuilt tail meshes. This is a mode selector, not a continuous adjustment.
geneDescriptions.PAT_SPLIT: Controls split between coat colour regions.
geneDescriptions.PAT_PERLIN2: Secondary noise layer for coat patterning.
geneDescriptions.NARCOLEPSY: Horse randomly falls asleep when idle if nonzero. Keep A, T, or C to avoid random sleep; G is the only narcoleptic value.
geneDescriptions.SPEED_FACTOR: Primary movement speed multiplier. T=133 is the highest-value allele for speed-focused builds.
geneDescriptions.NECK_SPEED: Controls neck swing and extension animation speed.
geneDescriptions.RAMPAGE: Rampage/aggression state value. Wiki mapping places C as active value 1; A, T, and G are 0. During rampage, locomotion signals may be overridden and the horse may fight, bolt, and flee.
geneDescriptions.SPINAL_LOCO: Controls locomotion mode: 0 = legs only, 1 = mild spinal undulation, 2 = full serpentine/worm-like movement. A gives the maximum serpentine mode; C/G are safest for normal racing movement.
geneDescriptions.HIGH_INTELLECT: Enables progression to genius behaviour. T and G are active; A and C are inactive. Required for philosophical/refusal states.
geneDescriptions.L_LEG_SIGNAL: Broadcast signal ID emitted by legs during locomotion.
geneDescriptions.L_ARM_SIGNAL: Broadcast signal ID emitted by arms/front limbs during locomotion.
geneDescriptions.LOCO_SYNC: Global locomotion synchronisation flag. T enables coordinated limb timing; A/C/G leave limbs free-running, which can produce chaotic motion.
geneDescriptions.L_LEG_FTOB_REACT: Leg listener for forward-to-back power stroke.
geneDescriptions.L_LEG_FTOB_EVENT: Signal emitted by leg after forward-to-back stroke.
geneDescriptions.L_LEG_BTOF_REACT: Leg listener for back-to-forward recovery stroke.
geneDescriptions.L_LEG_BTOF_EVENT: Signal emitted by leg after back-to-forward stroke.
geneDescriptions.L_ARM_FTOB_REACT: Arm listener for forward-to-back power stroke.
geneDescriptions.L_ARM_FTOB_EVENT: Signal emitted by arm after forward-to-back stroke.
geneDescriptions.L_ARM_BTOF_REACT: Arm listener for back-to-forward recovery stroke.
geneDescriptions.L_ARM_BTOF_EVENT: Signal emitted by arm after back-to-forward stroke.
geneDescriptions.L_TAIL_FTOB_REACT: Tail listener for forward movement phase.
geneDescriptions.L_TAIL_FTOB_EVENT: Signal emitted by tail after forward phase.
geneDescriptions.L_TAIL_BTOF_REACT: Tail listener for recovery movement phase.
geneDescriptions.L_TAIL_BTOF_EVENT: Signal emitted by tail after recovery phase.
geneDescriptions.L_NECK_FTOB_REACT: Neck listener for forward movement phase.
geneDescriptions.L_NECK_FTOB_EVENT: Signal emitted by neck after forward phase.
geneDescriptions.L_NECK_BTOF_REACT: Neck listener for recovery movement phase.
geneDescriptions.L_NECK_BTOF_EVENT: Signal emitted by neck after recovery phase.
